title: tc-failure-clusters
description:
Failing chats grouped by topic, biggest first – a size bar, count and share, trend in words and the criteria each
fails; open a cluster for its summary, quotes, Open chats, Add to dataset and Mark as known.

description.description: One line under the heading – the agent and the period

clusters.description: The clusters, in any order – shown biggest first, known ones last

total.description: All failing chats in the period; by default the clusters' counts added up

open.description: The open cluster's id. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

known.description: The clusters marked as known (ids). Changed by the user unless a tc-known-change listener calls preventDefault()

criterion.description: Only clusters failing this criterion; null for all. Changed by the user unless a tc-criterion-change listener calls preventDefault()

view.description: "list" or "bubbles". Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

labels.description: The words used, merged over the defaults

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

label.description: The topic, in a few words: "Expense limits abroad"

summary.description: What goes wrong in these chats, in a sentence or two

count.description: How many failing chats are in it

share.description: Its share of all failing chats, 0–1; by default count / total

criteria.description: The criteria these chats fail, by name: ["Cites policy"]

examples.description: A few quotes from the chats

direction.description: Which way the cluster moved over the period

change.description: By how much, in percent (12 for 12%)
